safety.title: Stop and rest
safety.rested: I've rested and I feel normal again

workout.tooHardHint: We can lighten the rest of the workout so you can finish it instead of stopping.
workout.pausedBody: Take your time. The timer is stopped.
workout.blockDone: All sets done. Move to the next exercise.
workout.tooHardRest: This is too hard or I need changes
workout.unwellHint: Chest pain, dizziness or severe discomfort: stop and get safety guidance.
workout.adjustLead: Completed sets are always kept. Changes apply to what's left.

too-hard.label: This is too hard
too-hard.hint: Lighter loads, softer reps and a bit more rest.

easier.label: Make it easier
easier.hint: About 10% lighter or an easier variation.

replace.label: Replace this exercise
replace.hint: Swap it for one that fits your equipment.

min20.label: I only have 20 minutes
min20.hint: Keeps the essentials and trims the rest.

tired.label: I'm feeling tired
tired.hint: Fewer sets, lighter loads, longer rests.

pause.label: Pause workout
pause.hint: Stops the timers until you resume.

end.label: End workout
end.hint: Save what you've done and finish.

workout.endBody: Your {n} completed sets will be saved as a partial workout.
workout.endEmpty: You haven't logged any sets. Leave without saving?
workout.quitLead: Pick the closest reason. We'll help you with it before you quit.
workout.reasonUnwell: I don't feel well right now
workout.reasonHardHint: Make the rest of the workout easier and carry on.
workout.reasonUnsure: I don't know how to do this
workout.reasonUnsureHint: Swap this exercise for another one.

summary.title: Workout complete
summary.lead: {title} is done. Here's how it went.
summary.partialLead: You stopped early and that's fine. What you did still counts.
summary.emptyBody: Nothing to save this time. Come back whenever you're ready.
summary.avgHr: Average heart rate {n} bpm (simulated, demo mode).
summary.adaptNote: Your next sessions take your feedback into account.
summary.feelNote: Your answer tunes the loads in your next sessions.
summary.discardBody: This session will not be saved and won't count toward progress.
